description: This Java source file defines a test class 'CredentialsJmsIT' which extends 'CredentialsApiTests'. It tests the Credentials service implementation using a JMS-based client, including setup and teardown methods, and several test cases for invalid request scenarios.

classes.name: CredentialsJmsIT
